consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance was strong, with several standout moments, particularly in the second set. However, some reviewers noted that the show was shorter than expected and lacked the special energy of other shows from the same year.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 16 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance, the shorter length and some criticisms of the setlist contributed to a more tempered overall sentiment.
